name: Aiman
text: Aiman logged the tanker discharge and checked the seals on both hoses before the driver left the yard. No drips found.

name: Kosovic
text: Kosovic completed the quarterly calibration of the air quality sensors on floors one to four. Readings sat inside tolerance on every unit. The gas cell on the third floor unit was swapped as a precaution and the old one was kept for the service record.

name: Gjeme Ardic
text: Gjeme Ardic attended the water leak in the archive room and shut the supply to the damaged riser before it spread further. Wet boxes were moved to the drying room and listed for the insurer. The plumber replaced a cracked elbow joint and pressure tested the line. Fans ran overnight and the moisture meter read dry by the morning.

name: Aykan Sayici
text: Aykan Sayici checked the rodent bait stations around the warehouse and replaced two that were empty. No activity in the traps.

name: Eyaz
text: Eyaz worked through the induction checklist with the new starter and booked the safety video slot for Thursday. The locker was issued and the door fob was activated. Paperwork went to payroll the same afternoon, so the first payslip should land without a manual fix.

name: Ferdinandi
text: Ferdinandi signed off the annual boiler service after the engineer fitted a new expansion vessel and flushed the system. Flue readings were inside the limits on both checks. A magnetic filter was added and the old one was left in the plant room for comparison. The service certificate went on the wall in the corridor.

name: Laux Fabing Compostella
text: Laux Fabing Compostella adjusted the CCTV camera over the back gate after the blind spot was flagged in the audit. The view was checked at the monitor.

name: De la Torre
text: De la Torre arranged the drain camera survey for the rear stack after two slow drains were logged on the same riser. The footage showed a root intrusion and a descale was booked with the jetting crew. No structural cracks were seen.

name: Thomas
text: Thomas supervised the deep clean of the kitchen canopy and the extract duct run above the west range. The contractor scraped two years of grease out of the plenum and the filters went through the dishwasher twice. Photos of the before and after went in the compliance file. The next clean is pencilled in for March.

name: Notegen
text: Notegen counted the sandbag stock in the flood store and found eighteen usable bags plus two pallets of loose sand. The torn bags were binned.

name: Rossmary Kopfberger
text: Rossmary Kopfberger reported the failed fire door closer on the east stair and taped the door open pending repair. The door was back in service by the afternoon. A note was added to the fire log.

name: De Davide
text: De Davide walked the tree survey along the car park edge with the arborist and marked five limes for crown lifting. Two dead cherries near the north gate were scheduled for removal before the autumn winds. The work order covers stump grinding and replanting with native stock.

name: Radu-Gabriel
text: Radu-Gabriel: press brake guard interlock slow to release, flagged for the electrician. Production moved to the small brake so the tray order stays on track.

name: Lauf
text: Lauf: spiral freezer door heater failed, ice building along the bottom rail each night. Element on order, manual defrost added to the closing round until it lands. Product quality unaffected so far.

name: Fiandaca Akenoun Benesch
text: Fiandaca Akenoun Benesch: paint booth extract filters changed, three of the four were well past the pressure limit. The booth was run empty for twenty minutes to clear the duct, and the airflow gauge settled square in the green. The next set is in the stores with the date written on the box. Spraying resumes in the morning.

name: von Au
text: von Au: scissor lift annual inspection passed, paperwork filed and the new sticker applied. One wheel brake was adjusted during the check.

name: Janie
text: Janie: pass-through dishwasher end rinse temperature drifting low, rinse booster maybe on its way out. Probe reading confirmed it on two cycles. Service call logged, parts under warranty. Use the manual sink until the engineer comes.

name: Tillott
text: Tillott: conveyor photoeye at the case erector keeps dropping out when the air is damp. Lens cleaned and the bracket squared, but it faulted again on the night shift. A heated enclosure is the fix the controls team recommends. Budget approval is pending, and until then the line runs with a manual reset.

name: von Vogt
text: von Vogt: ice machine flaker head stripped, no flake production since Tuesday. Loan unit on site and the part number is with the supplier.

name: Siyka Eponon
text: Siyka Eponon: dock leveller lip cracked at the hinge, bay 2 closed until the weld is repaired. The mobile ramp is in place for deliveries and the drivers have been briefed. Welder coming Friday with the replacement lip.

name: Luzius
text: Luzius: air compressor losing pressure overnight, likely the drain solenoid seeping. Tested the receiver with soapy water and found nothing at the joints. Replacement solenoid in stock, swap planned for the weekend shutdown. Logs from the night shift match the gauge drop. The drier cartridge was changed at the same time as a precaution.

name: Haussmann
text: Haussmann: autoclave door gasket replaced and the cycle test passed twice. Pressure strip is back under the limit. The next full load ran clean.

name: La Mazza
text: La Mazza: band saw blade guard sluggish on return, spring likely tired. Replaced from the parts drawer and the interlock was verified. No cuts have been scheduled until the sign off is completed, so the timber order goes to the panel saw for now.

name: Binnendijk Figliucci Sankaran
text: Binnendijk Figliucci Sankaran: forklift battery 7 not holding charge past four hours, cells 3 and 5 reading weak on the tester. Truck swapped to battery 4 and the charger is fine. Battery sent to the supplier for a warranty assessment. Spare truck is covering the late shift.

name: Ilka
text: The courier log was reconciled against the gate passes and every entry balanced. Ilka countersigned the sheet and filed it with the delivery notes.

name: Kudelski
text: The chiller stock was rotated and the date labels were checked against the delivery notes at the loading bay. Kudelski pulled six trays that were close to date and logged them for the kitchen. The replacement order went in before the evening service.

name: von Allmen-Feuz
text: The weekend security round was completed across both buildings and the patrol points scanned in order. von Allmen-Feuz noted a propped side door on the west block and secured it on the spot. A follow-up note went to the facilities inbox with a photo of the door. The guard on the next shift was briefed at handover.

name: Kenechukwu Jibriil
text: Two pallets were rejected at intake because the shrink wrap had split in transit. Kenechukwu Jibriil photographed the damage and raised the credit note with the supplier.

name: Teofana
text: The training matrix was updated after the refresher courses finished and the certificates were scanned into the shared folder. Teofana booked the two outstanding manual handling sessions for the new starters. The records are ready for the upcoming audit.

name: Mastrogiacomo
text: The warehouse temperature log was checked and the min max columns were fully filled in for every day of the week. Mastrogiacomo flagged two readings from the weekend that sat above the chill limit and referred them to the quality team. The door seals were rechecked afterwards and no obvious issue could be found.

name: Abou Brasic
text: The fire panel was showing a single fault on zone four overnight. Abou Brasic traced it to a dusty detector head and swapped it from stock.

name: Vivienne Maileen
text: The parcel locker was cleared and the aging overflow shelf was tidied before the courier run. Vivienne Maileen logged three unlabeled parcels and put them in the cage for a second attempt at delivery. Label stock was restocked at the same time.

name: Sim
text: The monthly toolbox talk ran for both crews and everyone present signed the sheet. Sim covered the new spill response steps and walked through where the kits live on each floor. A quiz followed and the scores went on the noticeboard. The next session is booked for the second Wednesday.

name: Philp
text: The visitor badges were counted and the missing three were written off after a sweep of the meeting rooms. Philp returned the spare lanyards to the cabinet.

name: Bohus Llewellyn Deage
text: The cold room alarm was tested and the dial through to the answering service worked first time. Bohus Llewellyn Deage replaced the backup battery and marked the test on the panel card. The next check is due at the end of the quarter.

name: Clementino Fábián
text: The quarterly pest inspection covered the canteen, the dry store, and both loading bays without any findings. Clementino Fábián walked the inspector through the new door brush strips and the bait map was initialed at each station. A follow-up visit is pencilled in for the spring and the certificate is displayed by the office.

name: Labourier
text: The window restrictors in the family rooms were checked and two loose screws were tightened. Labourier ordered replacements for the cracked catch on room nine.

name: Ediz
text: Trolley bay 3 has a sticking caster that pulls to the left under load. Ediz swapped the wheel set and the bay went back in service the same afternoon. One more caster is on order as a spare.

name: Scotzniovsky
text: The packing bench tape dispenser was replaced and the old one went to the workshop for repair. Scotzniovsky swept the bench area and restocked both carton sizes before the morning run. The label printer was reloaded with the correct stock and a test label came out clean. No downtime was recorded on the line.

name: Princesse Lansana
text: Shrink wrap stock is down to the last two rolls on the small machine. Princesse Lansana moved a pallet from the overstock bay so the team can keep packing.

name: Denic Lificiu
text: Two crates from the evening despatch were short picked and the labels were reprinted before the lorry left. Denic Lificiu checked the paperwork against the manifest and found the pack list fault. The order has been made good and the customer was told.

name: Meiko
text: The strap tensioner on the palletizer was drifting under full bales and the strap splice failed inspection twice. Meiko adjusted the cam and replaced the worn grip pad. A test run of thirty bales passed without a single snap. The maintenance card was updated and the spare pad was ordered.

name: Verdiani
text: The scrubber battery dies after an hour and leaves streaks by the dock. Verdiani booked it in for a service and asked for a loan unit.

name: Balnozan Niederau
text: The mezzanine spill kit was audited and the absorbent socks were swapped for fresh ones. Balnozan Niederau added a second pair of goggles and replaced the cracked lid on the bin. The kit tag was dated and initialed.

name: Honya Hambrecht
text: The tills were cashed up and the float was counted twice before the safe drop. Honya Hambrecht spotted a till roll shortage and added it to the order sheet for Monday. The card machine was wiped down and the terminals were left on charge overnight. The duty log shows no other issues.

name: Dása
text: The front display fridge is running warm and the seal is flat. Dása moved the milk to the backup fridge and taped a note to the door.

name: Budek
text: The click and collect shelf was cleared and two parcels went back to the cage for rebooking. Budek reprinted the labels and sent the confirmation texts again. The overnight locker code was reset at the same time.

name: Grandt Leserf Nouara
text: The coffee grinder on the bar was stripping its burr and the decaf hopper was jammed with old grounds. Grandt Leserf Nouara stripped and cleaned the whole assembly and swapped in a fresh burr set. The grind was dialled back in over a few shots. The machine is due for its full service in the new year.

name: Katzenbach Merizalde
text: The back gate latch was loose again and swung open in the wind. Katzenbach Merizalde fitted a longer striker and tested it twice.

name: Staine
text: The glass wash sink was draining slowly and the trap was full of debris from the bar. Staine rodded the run and flushed it through until the water pulled clean. A drain screen was fitted to catch the straws.
